verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists an official "Mobile SDK" as a paid add-on, and the company documents a Web API. However, the SDK appears only as a one-line pricing entry, and a REST API on its own is not an SDK. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both returned 404. missing for 10: SDK documentation and supported languages, desktop/server SDKs, published OpenAPI spec for generating clients, AI-agent-oriented SDK guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
